mapper.update: UPDATE ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common a, ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods b SET a.common_is_xian = 0 WHERE a.common_id = b.common_id AND a.common_id = #{commonId} AND b.seckill_goods_state= 1 AND a.common_is_xian = 2
mapper.select: select a.seckill_goods_id, a.common_id, a.goods_name, a.goods_price, a.seckill_price, a.goods_image,a.seckill_id,a.goods_upper_limit,a.seckill_num,a.goods_id,a.goods_start_time as startDateTime,a.shop_id from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods a where seckill_num = 0 and seckill_goods_state = 1

select a.seckill_goods_id, a.common_id, a.goods_name, a.goods_price, a.seckill_price, a.goods_image,a.seckill_id,a.goods_upper_limit,a.seckill_num,a.goods_id,a.goods_start_time as startDateTime,a.shop_id from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods a where seckill_num != 0 and seckill_id = #{seckillId}
